Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A combination product comprising: (A) BH4, a __specific__ functional derivative or __biosynthetic precursor of BH4 defined in the specification__, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its __specific__ derivative or precursor; and (B) an __identified__ inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII __as defined in the specification__, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, wherein each of components (A) and (B) is formulated in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a __specific__ functional derivative or __biosynthetic precursor of BH4 defined in the specification__, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its __specific__ derivative or precursor, an __identified__ inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII __as defined in the specification__, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, and a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a kit of parts comprising components: (I) a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a __specific__ functional derivative or __biosynthetic precursor of BH4 defined in the specification__, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its __specific__ derivative or precursor, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier; and (II) a pharmaceutical formulation including an __identified__ inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII __as defined in the specification__, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier, which components (I) and (II) are each provided in a form that is suitable for administration in conjunction with the other.

Claim 13 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in any one of the preceding claims, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII is selected from the group consisting of a __renin inhibitor, an ACE inhibitor, or an AT1 receptor antagonist as defined in the specification__.

Claim 14 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 13, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII is a compound selected from the group consisting of __those identified in the specification__.

Claim 15 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 14, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII is a compound selected from the group consisting of __identified compounds with known activity_.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in any one of the preceding claims, wherein the component that is BH4 or a __specific__ functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof is a compound of formula I, which is described in the specification.
